groups.activity: reach Agent, then buy the main blueprint
conditions: The old Rank 5 Solaris United / Profit-Taker prerequisite is gone. Rank 2 Vox Solaris is reachable without it.
Lazulite Toroids redeem for 12,000 Vox Solaris standing each, so the Exploiter farm pays the standing requirement.
bonuses: The Eudico heist bounty is optional matchmaking convenience, not a Hildryn gate.

conditions: Use a Diluted Thermia at the Thermic Condenser on Deck 12's upper-left balcony to begin.
You need six Lazulite Toroids regardless of where the blueprints come from. They drop only from Exploiter, never from Circuit.
An active Resource Booster plus a Retriever companion can double Lazulite, reducing the mandatory clears from six to three. Drop-chance boosters and relay blessings do not help.
Farm the Toroids before committing a Circuit week: many players finish the blueprints within the required 3-6 kills.
No event means no new Thermia. The boss remains available only if you already hold Thermia.
Only the player who inserts Thermia into Deck 12 spends it; recruit chat may find a host with spare keys.
bonuses: In phase 1, explode a Thermia canister between both rear vents to thaw both at once.
Carry orange Thermia cells to the phase-2 door; 24 cells cover all three overheats. Drag ground coolant canisters away from the Orb so she cannot re-cool herself.
Grab the drop and leave after her self-destruct; the explosion is lethal at long range but does not destroy loot.

disclosures.title: Circuit reduces blueprint RNG, not boss runs
disclosures.body: Circuit tiers 2, 5, 8 and 10 can award Hildryn component blueprints during her rotation, but every component still consumes two Lazulite Toroids. Use it only for a stubborn missing part after the Toroid farm.

conditions: Components build in parallel; keep a free Warframe slot for the final claim.
